messages.content: Write ONLY raw executable Python 3 code (no markdown fences, no explanations) that reads the CSV file in the current directory and prints ONLY the final answer to stdout. The harness handles any instruction to write answer.txt; your program must only print the result. Use the standard library. Read all rows; the preview is incomplete. Do not modify input files.

File: records.csv
Header & first rows:
region,sku,qty,price
north,a,2,7
south,b,5,3
north,b,4,11

Task: Read all rows of records.csv. Compute sum(qty*price)/sum(qty) over all rows and round DOWN to the nearest integer. Write only the number to answer.txt.
